dishes: A rice and lentil salad, served as a Passover-appropriate side dish.
notes: Rice and legumes (kitniyot) are a genuinely disputed category for Passover between different Jewish customs/communities, independent of the ingredients being kosher year-round. Expect CONDITIONAL with an explanation that acknowledges this depends on custom/community practice or certification for the holiday, rather than a confident flat KOSHER or NOT_KOSHER.
